Name: Heavy Furnace Enhanced
Author: DeyvidMods
Description:
Heavy Furnace Enhanced improves the vanilla Heavy Furnace while keeping its original purpose as a high-capacity furnace.

The mod combines two features in one package: configurable processing speed presets and automatic recipe compatibility with compatible recipes added to the regular Furnace by other mods.


RECIPE COMPATIBILITY

When another mod adds a compatible recipe to the regular Furnace, Heavy Furnace Enhanced checks whether the Heavy Furnace already supports that input.

If the Heavy Furnace already has its own recipe, the mod leaves it untouched.

If the recipe is missing and can be safely adapted, Heavy Furnace Enhanced automatically creates a Heavy Furnace version using the Heavy Furnace batch philosophy:

5x input → 5x base output

For example, if another mod adds:

100 Sap → 1 Glue

to the regular Furnace, Heavy Furnace Enhanced can automatically adapt it to:

500 Sap → 5 Glue

Recipes with ambiguous or unsupported structures are skipped instead of being modified blindly.


CONFIGURABLE SPEED PRESETS

Heavy Furnace Enhanced also includes configurable processing speed presets:

2x – All supported recipes process at 2x speed.

3x – Short recipes use 2x speed, while longer recipes use up to 3x speed.

4x – Processing speed scales between 2x, 3x and 4x depending on the original processing time.

5x – Processing speed scales between 2x, 3x and 5x depending on the original processing time.

A minimum processing time of 10 minutes is preserved.

GENERIC MOD CONFIG MENU

GMCM is supported and recommended, but not required.

With GMCM installed, you can enable or disable recipe compatibility and select your preferred Heavy Furnace speed preset directly in-game.


COMPATIBILITY

Heavy Furnace Enhanced is designed to work dynamically with the final Furnace recipes loaded by the game. This means compatible recipes added by other mods can be detected without requiring individual patches for every supported mod.

The mod does not replace existing Heavy Furnace recipes when the Heavy Furnace already supports the same input.


REQUIREMENTS

- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, recommended)


IMPORTANT

This mod enhances the vanilla Heavy Furnace. It does not give the player the Heavy Furnace or unlock its crafting recipe.

The Heavy Furnace must still be unlocked normally through Mining Mastery.
